# Pi Anthropic E2E acceptance cases

The Anthropic Messages models of the oracle Pi's catalog (Pi's own generator run over the recording in `automation/gen/catalog-source`) and the probes the upstream acceptance tests select from them come from `node test/parity/testdata/generate-anthropic-e2e-cases.mjs`, which `ai/anthropic_e2e_catalog_test.go` runs at test time. No snapshot is committed: a refresh of the recording changes the cases with no file edit. The selector preserves the priority and JavaScript `localeCompare` rules in `packages/ai/test/anthropic-eager-tool-input-e2e.test.ts:34-85` and `packages/ai/test/anthropic-long-cache-retention-e2e.test.ts:22-70`. The test checks the complete catalog denominator independently against Pig's catalog. It does not replace a remote response with fixture data.

Select the `live` build tag for the provider acceptance tests. The Anthropic thinking-disable and Bedrock thinking-payload cases that abort in `OnPayload` run in the default suite without credentials. Supply provider environment keys in an isolated home. Copilot uses `PIG_LIVE_COPILOT_TOKEN`, which contains the resolved token normally returned by the upstream OAuth helper. No test reads the worker's auth files. Missing credentials fail the selected live case. The selected catalog routes require Anthropic, Cloudflare AI Gateway (including account/gateway endpoint configuration), Fireworks, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Coding, MiniMax, MiniMax CN, OpenCode, OpenRouter, and Vercel AI Gateway access.
